items.html: The third is lesser than both, and it is all the remaining souls, which are all the lights of the nine lower, separate phases in every Sefira of the ten Sefirot, in every Partzuf of the ten Partzufim mentioned above. Over these the Klipot ruled through the sin of Adam HaRishon, and they fell from him into the depths of the Klipot, and their correction will not be completed until Mashiach Ben David comes, as mentioned above. And when all of them are completed to come into the world and be corrected, then Mashiach Ben David comes.
